_comment: Seed findings for codemender-scan.yml mode=mock. Lab data only. commit_sha is filled in by the workflow at scan time.

findings.title: SQL injection in get_transactions
findings.description: get_transactions() interpolates the account query parameter into the SQL text with an f-string. Input such as ' OR '1'='1 returns transactions for every account. Reachable from GET /api/transactions?account=. Fix: use a parameterized query.

findings.title: Path traversal in read_receipt
findings.description: read_receipt() joins data/receipts/ with the file query parameter without normalizing the result. ../ sequences read files outside the receipts directory. Reachable from GET /api/receipts?file=. Fix: resolve the path and require it to stay inside the receipts directory.

findings.title: Cloud Run service account granted roles/editor at project level
findings.description: payment-service-sa is bound to roles/editor on the whole project. The service needs no project-wide permissions. A compromise of the service (for example through CM-0001) gives write access to most project resources. Fix: remove the binding and grant only the specific roles the service needs.

findings.title: End-of-life base image python:3.8-slim-buster
findings.description: The image is built FROM python:3.8-slim-buster. Python 3.8 and Debian 10 (buster) are end of life and get no security fixes. Fix: move to a supported base such as python:3.12-slim-bookworm and rebuild.
